convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for 'MACD_Xtr' custom indicator with unknown internal logic, plus #include <TradeAlgorithms.mqh> external library for position management. Custom indicator buffer values (0,1,2) drive all signals, requiring manual Python reimplementation of both the MACD_Xtr indicator and the trade algorithm helpers.

derived_values.name: Signal buffer value (0=short trend, 1=no trend, 2=long trend)
derived_values.formula: MACD_Xtr buffer 1[bar] returns {0,1,2} discretized trend state

derived_values.name: Signal change detection
derived_values.formula: Signal[1]!=Signal[0] detects transition between trend states

other_exits: Close long when MACD_Xtr signal buffer == 0 (opposite trend detected) and BuyPosClose is true
Close short when MACD_Xtr signal buffer == 2 (opposite trend detected) and SellPosClose is true
Close both long and short when MACD_Xtr signal buffer == 1 (no trend) and respective close permission is true

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MM=-0.1 means negative value is treated as fixed lot size (0.1); positive values would be deposit fraction

custom_logic_notes: The MACD_Xtr custom indicator must be fully reverse-engineered. It takes Fast/Slow EMA periods plus a 'source' enum (VOLUME/ATR/STDEV) with its own period, front/back smoothing periods, volatility multiplier, and sensitivity threshold. It outputs 3 discrete states (0=short, 1=neutral, 2=long) on buffer index 1. Entry requires a state TRANSITION (Signal[1]!=Signal[0]) not just a state value. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose/GlobalVariableDel_/LoadHistory helper functions that manage position opening with signal time tracking and closing logic. The signal time is used as a position identifier/timestamp for the trade algorithm library. When SignalBar==0, the EA checks every tick instead of only on new bars.
backtest_data_needs: Symbol H4 730 days with tick volume
python_conversion_notes: 1) Must reimplement MACD_Xtr indicator: compute Fast/Slow EMA, derive source series (ATR/StDev/Tick Volume) with period, apply front smoothing (period 1 = no smoothing) and back damping smoothing (EMA period 444), then discretize with xVolatility and Sens threshold into 3 states {0,1,2}. 2) Must reimplement TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions for position management including signal-time-based tracking. 3) Entry signals require state transition detection (prev_state != curr_state), not just threshold comparison. 4) Position sizing: negative MM = fixed lot, positive = deposit fraction. 5) New-bar gate with fallback to every-tick when SignalBar=0.
